description: Single take of a scripted tour: every displayed hyprhand command really ran against a managed headless session; a stand-in desktop shows the terminal and the PiP.

software.aquamarine: 0.15.1 with the experimental headless format bridge

sessions.demo-host: headless 1024x1024; stands in for the user's desktop (terminal + PiP)
sessions.agent: headless 1024x576 created by the script; Brave shows examples/tour/northwind.html

human_input: The 'human' clicks and keystrokes in the PiP (Take over, password, captcha, Sign in, Return) were sent with hyprhand to the demo-host session, i.e. to the PiP window, exactly as a person's mouse and keyboard would be. The PiP forwarded them to the agent session.

edit.notes: Waits while the recorder placed the PiP and measured the human's click targets were cut; segments play at 1x-2x. No synthetic cursor, captions or interpolation.

hidden_steps: Agent session display set to 1024x576 and gaps disabled right after creation (hyprctl in that session) so the PiP shows it at 1:1.
PiP window resized to 1024x632 and moved to the top of the stand-in desktop.
Hyprland donation/update notices disabled in both sessions.
